title: Nokia buys optical networking firm Infinera for $2.3B

sources.quote: today announced a definitive agreement under which Nokia will acquire Infinera in a transaction valuing the company at $6.65 per share or an enterprise value of US$ 2.3 billion.
Infinera acquisition completed during Q1, increasing Nokia's scale in Optical Networks and with hyperscalers.

explain: Nokia paid $6.65 a share, mostly in cash, for Infinera, a US maker of optical networking equipment that carries data between data centers. Nokia said it wanted more scale selling to hyperscalers (the giant cloud companies). The deal closed in February 2025.
